title: Unob Tweaks
description: A small resourcepack that makes some Minecraft textures less obtrusive.
body:
## What is it?
Useful Minecraft resourcepack that makes some textures _unobtrusive_. It can be useful for PVP or for other aspects of playing Minecraft. 
## Features
- Smaller swords;
- Improved first-person view of the shield;
- Clear enchanted arrowheads without particles;
- Improved first-person view of fire;
- Improved first-person view of the totem and reduction of its particles.
